notes: A jump catch, and the first movement with a stance that changes. hipDrop per key loads the legs, extends through the jump, then absorbs on landing. Arms are almost straight at the top, the ball comes to the chest on the way down, and the momentum carries into the release.

keys.name: gather
keys.note: Loading before the jump, hands ready but low.

keys.name: rise
keys.note: Going up, hands reaching for the ball.

keys.name: contact
keys.note: At the top, arms almost straight in front. Fingers up, thumbs in the middle.

keys.name: pull_in
keys.note: The ball comes in to the chest as she comes down.

keys.name: release
keys.note: The momentum of the catch goes straight back out as the pass.
